description.en: The IEC 60320 C14 appliance inlet: a three-pin (line, neutral, earth), 10 A, class I mains inlet whose recess (24 × 16 mm inside) takes a C13 connector one way up.
description.es: La entrada de aparato IEC 60320 C14: una entrada de red de tres pines (fase, neutro, tierra), 10 A y clase I, cuyo hueco (24 × 16 mm por dentro) recibe un conector C13 en una sola posición.
description.fr: Le socle de connecteur CEI 60320 C14 : une entrée secteur à trois broches (phase, neutre, terre), 10 A, classe I, dont le logement (24 × 16 mm à l'intérieur) reçoit un connecteur C13 dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A entrada de aparelho IEC 60320 C14: uma entrada de rede de três pinos (fase, neutro, terra), 10 A e classe I, cujo rebaixo (24 × 16 mm por dentro) recebe um conector C13 num só sentido.

sources.title: Qualtek 701W-X2/04 AC receptacle (IEC 60320 C14 snap-in inlet), drawing rev E (2021-06-22)
sources.supports: flange 30.7 × 23.7 ±0.3, 3.2 ±0.2 thick; recess (inside) 24 × 16 +0.5/0; body 26.7 × 19.8 ±0.3, 16 below the flange; three pins (line, neutral, earth above them); panel cut-out 27 × 20.5 +0.3/0; panel 0.8–1.5; UL/CSA 15 A, VDE/CCC 10 A, 250 V AC; 6.3 × 0.8 quick-connect tabs

sources.title: Qualtek 703W-00/03 AC receptacle (IEC 60320 C14 screw mount), drawing rev C (2008-08-28)
sources.supports: recess (inside) 24 × 16 +0.5/0; front block 30 × 22, R5 corners; screw holes 40 ±0.2 apart, Ø3.4 in the part and Ø3.5 in the panel; panel cut-out 30.5 × 22.5, R5; UL/CSA 15 A, VDE 10 A, 250 V AC

sources.title: Qualtek product pages 771W-X2/01, 701W-X2/04 and 703W-00/03
sources.supports: 771W-X2/01: IEC 60320 C8 low-current inlet; 701W-X2/04: IEC 60320 C14 universal snap-in AC power inlet; 703W-00/03: IEC 60320 C14 non-countersunk screw mount

sources.title: Schurter 6130-56 IEC appliance inlet C14, snap-in, front side, PCB, datasheet (2015-04-22)
sources.supports: appliance inlet C14 according to IEC 60320; IEC 10 A / 250 VAC; protection class I; front flange 30 × 22, 3 thick, 25.3 deep behind it; cut-out 27.5 × 19.5, R4, +0.2/0, for panels of 1 to 3

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the recess on the inlet's front (mating) face, the flange's face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing from the line and neutral pins toward the earth pin. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

rated_current.note: VDE/CCC; UL/CSA 15 A; Schurter IEC 10 A (source 3)

interfaces.note: Female: a C13 connector's nose enters the recess. Symmetry 1: the earth pin sits off the line of the other two (both makers' drawings), so the C13 goes in one way up.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: IEC 60320 is not freely published, so the facts are one inlet's drawing (Qualtek 701W, snap-in); Qualtek's screw-mount 703W draws the same 24 × 16 recess and Schurter's 6130-56 confirms the designation, the 10 A rating and class I. The flange, body and cut-out are this part's.

envelope.note: The flange and the body as boxes, centred on the recess (a convention: the drawing does not dimension the recess's offset); the tabs are not modelled.
